endorsements.quote: Rigorous auditing of multidomain models, including assessment of differential performance across population subgroups, is therefore essential.
Engaging patients, communities, and other stakeholders in decisions about data use and AI deployment can help align technological innovation with societal values and lived experience.

unlisted_practices: Compare integrated multidomain AI models against simpler models to justify added complexity.
Implement AI-enabled clinical decision support so it supports rather than overrides professional judgment.
Transparently document data sources, modeling choices, and intended use of AI models for accountability.
Address data ownership, consent, security, and appropriate use in ethical governance of linked multimodal data.
Perform sensitivity analyses and explicit uncertainty quantification to address measurement error and missingness across data domains in integrated models.
Integrate causal inference methods with AI models to distinguish association from causation.

screen.reason: Conceptual framework and analysis paper introducing the 'Health Elements' concept and discussing governance and ethical considerations for AI-enabled health systems.
